title: Are there different types of autism?
metaTitle: Understanding Different Types of Autism - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Autism comes with varied symptoms, abilities, and severity. Explore Pinnacle Blooms Network’s tailored support and therapy services for every unique aspect of Autism Spectrum Disorder.
html: Yes, definitely. Autism is a spectrum disorder, indicating a broad range of conditions characterized by varying levels of difficulty with social skills, repetitive behaviors, speech and nonverbal communication. The term 'spectrum' in Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) captures this diversity in symptoms and their severity. At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we tailor our therapy and support services considering these unique and individual needs of each child diagnosed with autism.
